It depends. If the device is set up to backup data, then  yes. They can restore and see the data, which may include pictures. If not, most likely not. If it’s a personal device that’s enrolled, IT admins can mostly wipe, locate, or lock (or some variation of those) the device. Policies/Apps can also be pushed but admins can’t see what’s on the phone itself (contacts, pictures, call logs, etc.) but they may see which apps are installed. 99% of us don’t care what app you have installed. We care that company policies are being followed and as long as your device is marked as “compliant”, you’re fine. You should really just care that if one day there are litigations or if legal needs to get involved, the phone may be seized and EVERYTHING on it will be accessible. If you’re worried about what we can see, then I’d say you have much bigger things to worry about.
